answer: Work waits on the signal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the yarrow of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the lantern of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
